query:
SELECT 
  s.id as search_id,
  s.name as campaign_name,
  COUNT(c.id) as total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.enrichmentStatus = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.enrichmentStatus = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.primaryDomain IS NULL OR c.primaryDomain = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_domain,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.websiteUrl IS NULL OR c.websiteUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_website
FROM searches s
JOIN companies c ON c.searchId = s.id
WHERE s.name ILIKE '%intertraffic%' OR s.name ILIKE '%conference%'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY s.id DESC
LIMIT 10;
